l2: 一元微分学（求导与作图）
question: 设 $y = \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - x^2}} \arcsin x$ ，求 $y^{(n)}(0)$ .
answer: y ^ {(n)} (0) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} {\left[ (n - 1)!! \right] ^ {2}, n \text {为奇数},} \\ {0, \qquad \qquad \qquad n \text {为偶数}.} \end{array} \right.

steps.text: 分析 逐次求导很难找到规律，函数式变形为 $y\sqrt{1 - x^2} = \arcsin x$ ，两边求导化简后就可看出适合用高阶导数的莱布尼兹公式.
y ^ {\prime} \sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}} + \frac {- x}{\sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}}} y = \frac {1}{\sqrt {1 - x ^ {2}}} \Rightarrow (1 - x ^ {2}) y ^ {\prime} - x y - 1 = 0.\tag{①}
用莱布尼兹公式在①式两边对 $x$ 求 $n - 1$ 阶导数 $(n\geqslant 2)$ ，得

solution.final_answer: y ^ {(n)} (0) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} {\left[ (n - 1)!! \right] ^ {2}, n \text {为奇数},} \\ {0, \qquad \qquad \qquad n \text {为偶数}.} \end{array} \right.
